entities.name: Arzakon's War
entities.description: Conflict on Shandalar centuries after the Wizards' War in which Arzakon corrupted the five guildlords.

entities.name: Arzakon
entities.description: Antagonist who sought entry to Shandalar and was banished.

entities.name: The Guardian of Shandalar
entities.description: Protector of Shandalar, killed in physical form by the guildlords but persisting as a spirit.

entities.name: Great Barrier
entities.description: The protective barrier that Arzakon sought to pierce.

entities.name: Skavius Slan
entities.description: Immortal lichlord and one of the five guildlords.

entities.name: Spell of Dominion
entities.description: A spell promised to give supreme authority, secretly meant to pierce the Great Barrier.

events.summary: Arzakon deceives the five guildlords with the Spell of Dominion, and they rebel and kill the Guardian's physical form.
events.quote: the guildlords rebelled against The Guardian , successfully killing his physical form

events.summary: The Guardian's spirit warns and trains a novice spellcaster who defeats the five guildlords in turn.
events.quote: the novice spellcaster methodically defeated them, neutralizing their threat

events.summary: The weakened Great Barrier lets Arzakon enter Shandalar; the spellcaster defeats and banishes him.
events.quote: suffered defeat, resulting in his banishment from the plane for an indefinite period

relations.quote: Following his initial defeat by The Guardian of Shandalar and the protective Great Barrier

relations.note: Deceived and manipulated him as a guildlord.
